# تَشَايَظْتِ (tašāyaẓti) /ta.ʃaː.jaðˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَايَظَ (tašāyaẓa)
# تَشَايَظَتْ (tašāyaẓat) /ta.ʃaː.ja.ðˤat/: third-person
